summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are on a skiing holiday. Since Kogoro has lost the key to their ski lodge, they accept Professor Masashi Oyama's invitation to his lodge. At dinner, they meet his assistants, who are celebrating the success of his latest publication. After dinner, everyone goes their separate ways. Kaori Nakahara, who forgot something while shopping, goes back to get groceries for the others, Professor Oyama watches his favorite TV show, Ginji Tobita goes night skiing, and Tomoyasu Kanazawa takes a bath. While Kogoro sleeps off his hangover, Conan and Ran help Kaho Ezumi with the dishes. A dark figure sneaks up behind Professor Oyama. Knowing he was dying, Oyama left a dying message for Kogoro, whom he greatly admires. Victim: Masashi Oyama Cause of death: Multiple stab wounds to the back Suspects: Kaori Nakahara, Tomoyasu Kanazawa, Ginji Tobita, and Kaho Ezumi Since it's already past 11:00 PM, Kaori goes to check on him and finds him dead, tied up and gagged in his room, with a knife in his back. Because the police can't come due to the snowstorm, Kogoro temporarily takes over the investigation. He photographs the crime scene and discovers scratch marks on the safe. Conan, who finds the victim's sitting position and the trail of blood leading there odd, deduces that the bloodstained blanket on the floor must have originally been on the table and might be an obituary. Footprints are visible in the snow in front of the broken window. Kogoro asks the doctors to examine the body. The time of death must have been between 9:30 and 10:00 PM; Oyama slowly suffocated from the stab wound in his lung. Conan refutes Kogoro's theory of a robbery by a stranger by pointing out the gold watch left behind and the fact that the perpetrator entered the room directly without scouting the area beforehand. This arouses suspicion, and Kogoro questions them about their alibis.
